The castle st. croix - luxury resort and wedding venue usvi
Luxury Resort St. Croix, US Virgin Islands
Situated on over 102 acres next to the St. Croix Yacht Club, this hilltop estate is one of the territory's most iconic and extraordinary properties. With six bedrooms, six bathrooms, a sprawling 9,500-square-foot footprint, and additional villas to stay at, The Castle St. Croix stands as a magnificent architectural marvel.
Continue
Wedding Venue St. Croix, US Virgin Islands
Relax in style and comfort at The Castle St. Croix. With a variety of room types to choose from, including suites and villas, you'll find the perfect accommodations for your stay. Our rooms are designed with your comfort in mind, featuring plush bedding and modern amenities.
Learn more
Luxury Vacation Rental St. Croix, US Virgin Islands
While the castle is a world unto itself, it also boasts proximity to some of St. Croix's most picturesque and sought-after destinations. From the crystal-clear waters and sandy beaches to the vibrant culture and historic sites, the U.S. Virgin Islands provide the perfect backdrop for your vacation. Whether your guests are traveling from afar or simply across the island, they'll find themselves enchanted by the surrounding beauty.

Visit castle st. Croix
Address
13 North Slob, Christiansted, 00820, U.S. Virgin Islands
Directions from the East End
Drive East on East End Rd past the turn for Point Udall.
Go around the bend (don't turn towards Point Udall)
Take the second right turn (a sharp right) onto Ridge Rd. (NOT S. Ridge Road)
Drive over the hill where the paved road turns into a dirt road.
Keep left at the fork & you will reach a black gate to enter the castle.
Directions from the STX Airport
Merge onto E. Airport Rd/RTE 64
Turn right onto Melvin H Evans Hwy
Follow Melvin H. Evans Hwy to the 4th stop light and turn right onto Hess Road (.7 miles)
Follow Hess Road until it comes to a T, and then turn left onto Hope Road (.6 miles)
Follow Hope Road until it T’s and turn right onto Southside Road (5.7 miles)
Slight left onto Lowry Hill Rod/Petronella Rd/Southside Road (1.0 miles)
Turn right onto Great Pond Bypass (.8 miles)
Turn right onto s. Shore Road/Southgate-great pond rd/Tipperary Rd (5.7 miles)
Sharp left onto Ridge Road (.3 miles)
Follow Southside Road until it makes a sharp left turn onto Ridge Road
Drive over the hill where the paved road turns into a dirt road.
Keep left at the fork & you will reach a black gate to enter the castle.
